reuse.why: Fintegra linking reuses the tree's linkBankSyncAccount and link.findOrCreateBank, and every provider calls one guard, but the download and the unlink reset are rewritten instead of shared.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the Akahu/EnableBanking download body, and the replace path copies unlinkAccount's field reset verbatim.

placement.why: The guard sits with the link handlers in accounts/app.ts, but SyncServerFintegraAccount is declared in types/models/simplefin.ts rather than in its own provider module.

scope.why: Only the four requested behaviours plus the provider registration (server config, SYNC_PROVIDERS) are touched.

maintainability.why: A guard named assertBankAccountNotLinked that also checks closed accounts and unlinks the holder misleads readers, and the two copied blocks will drift from their originals.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions is the Akahu/EnableBanking download compressed onto fewer lines (inline object literals, one-line destructuring) rather than shared; the unlink reset in assertBankAccountNotLinked is a verbatim copy.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked (accounts/app.ts) gained a replaceExistingLink flag that turns an assertion into a mutation, and a closed-account branch unrelated to its name; all six link handlers call it.
